suggestions.label: Shape this board for my business
suggestions.prompt: Shape this board for how my business works: read board.config.json and the examples in examples/, ask me only what you cannot infer from this project, then set the vocabulary, columns, tags and card fields, restart the service, and show me. We are:

suggestions.label: Import the spreadsheet I use today
suggestions.prompt: I track this work in a spreadsheet today. I will attach it; map its columns to the board's fields with node scripts/import.mjs --dry-run first, show me the mapping, then import it.

suggestions.label: What needs attention?
suggestions.prompt: Using node scripts/items.mjs, show me the unfinished items that need attention first (overdue, urgent, stale in progress, columns over their limit) and say why in one line each.

suggestions.label: Add items from what I tell you
suggestions.prompt: I will describe work in plain words; add each as an item with node scripts/items.mjs add, picking the column, due date, tags and assignee from what I say, and confirm in a short list. Here is the work:
